sections.intro: Same flavors she likes, made a slightly new way.

sections.title: More Tex-Mex
sections.intro: About 25 of her meals are Tex-Mex. These add new ways to use the toppings she already buys.

sections.title: Takeout she could make herself
sections.intro: Things she has ordered and photographed. Each one uses skills she has already shown.

sections.title: More weeknight dinners
sections.intro: A second round, picked to cover more proteins. Each one takes about 40 minutes or less.

sections.title: Slow cooker
sections.intro: She already uses a slow cooker (a soup on Dec 2, 2024). These take about 20 minutes of prep, then cook on their own. The birria tacos in the Tex-Mex section are also slow-cooker recipes.

sections.title: Warm and cozy
sections.intro: Four new recipes for crisp fall days. The "Warm & cozy" filter also finds the soups, stews, bakes and slow-cooker dishes elsewhere on the page, including ones she has already made.

sections.title: Pasta & Italian
sections.intro: Her biggest category. These are my versions of what's in the photos, not her exact recipes. Cards marked Likely or Best guess are the ones I'm less sure about.

recipes.title: Salmon sushi bake
recipes.note: Three poke bowls this month (Oct 13–16, 2026) and salmon over rice with scallions five times (March 2025, August 2026). This is the same idea, baked as a casserole.
steps: Cook the rice and season it with rice vinegar, a little sugar and salt. Press it into an 8×8 dish and sprinkle with furikake.
Bake the salmon at 400°F for 12–15 min. Flake it and mix with 2 oz cream cheese, ¼ cup mayo and sriracha to taste.
Spread over the rice. Bake 10 min, then broil 2 min until it browns in spots.
Top with scallions and more sriracha mayo. Scoop onto the seaweed sheets with avocado and cucumber.

recipes.title: Ahi tuna on crispy rice
recipes.note: She already sears tuna: sliced over avocado and cucumber (Feb 2025), sesame-crusted (Mar 30, 2026), and in the October bowls. Crispy rice adds crunch.
steps: Press cold rice ¾ inch thick into a lined pan. Chill 1 hour, then cut into squares.
Pan-fry the squares in oil until golden on both sides.
Coat the tuna in sesame seeds. Sear 30–45 seconds per side and slice thin.
Top each square with avocado, tuna and a thin slice of jalapeño. Spoon over a little ponzu.

recipes.title: Creamy vodka rigatoni
recipes.note: Pasta is her biggest category. She makes both red sauce (rigatoni, Jul 2024; pappardelle, Aug 2026) and cream sauce (shrimp alfredo, Sep 2024). Vodka sauce is both at once.
steps: Soften a minced shallot and 2 cloves of garlic in butter.
Add ¼ cup tomato paste and cook, stirring, until it turns brick-red (about 4 min). Add a splash of vodka and let it bubble off.
Stir in ¾ cup cream and a pinch of chili flakes.
Toss with the pasta, a splash of pasta water and a big handful of parmesan. Top with basil and more parm.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with garlic toast
recipes.note: Eggs are her most common breakfast, she made a tomato and egg scramble (Aug 13, 2025), and garlic toast is her usual side.
steps: Cook the sliced onion and pepper until soft. Add garlic, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika.
Add a 28 oz can of crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 min.
Make wells and crack in 4–5 eggs. Cover and cook 5–8 min, until the whites set.
Finish with feta and herbs. Serve with garlic toast for dipping.

recipes.title: Loaded sweet potatoes with chipotle black beans
recipes.note: She's made loaded potatoes about eight times (bacon, sour cream and scallions in Oct 2025; buffalo chicken in Nov 2024) and a sweet potato with ground beef (Jul 21, 2026).
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F for 45–60 min, until soft.
Warm the beans and corn with 1 minced chipotle and a spoon of the adobo sauce.
Stir lime juice into the sour cream.
Split the potatoes and fill with the beans. Drizzle the lime sour cream in lines, then top with cotija, scallions and avocado.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas
recipes.note: She made a sliced chicken bowl with peppers, corn and black beans (May 18, 2026) and steak tacos (Nov 18, 2025). This makes the filling on one pan.
steps: Slice everything into strips. Toss with oil, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp each cumin, paprika and garlic powder, plus salt.
Spread on a sheet pan in one layer and roast at 425°F for 20–25 min.
Squeeze lime over the top and serve in warm tortillas or over rice.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker birria tacos
recipes.note: She uses a slow cooker (Dec 2, 2024), makes beef stew (Oct 2025, Mar 2026) and steak tacos. These are cheesy, crispy tacos you dip in their own broth.

items: dried guajillo or ancho chiles (or 3 Tbsp chili powder)

steps: Soak the chiles in hot water for 10 min. Blend with the chipotle, half the onion, garlic, spices and 2 cups broth.
Pour over the beef and cook on low for 8 hr. Shred the meat.
Dip each tortilla in the red fat on top of the broth. Griddle it with cheese and beef, then fold.
Serve with a cup of broth for dipping, plus onion, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Pad see ew
recipes.note: She ordered pad see ew (Aug 21, 2025) and pad thai (Dec 15, 2024), and she already makes chicken and broccoli stir-fry (Jan 2025).
steps: Mix the sauce: 2 Tbsp oyster sauce, 1 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 Tbsp dark soy and 2 tsp sugar (for 2 servings).
Stir-fry the chicken and garlic over high heat. Add the broccoli for 2 min.
Push everything aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce. Let them sit undisturbed for 30 seconds at a time so they char a little.

recipes.title: Hibachi fried rice with yum yum sauce
recipes.note: She makes egg fried rice in a skillet (Mar 3, 2026), ordered hibachi (Sep 14, 2024), and puts a mayo sauce on all her bowls.
steps: Sauce: ½ cup mayo, 1 Tbsp ketchup, 1 Tbsp melted butter, ¼ tsp each garlic powder and paprika, 1 tsp sugar, a splash of water. Chill.
Cook the protein in butter and set it aside. Soften the onion, peas and carrots.
Add the rice, a big pat of butter, garlic and soy sauce. Scramble in the eggs.
Return the protein. Drizzle the sauce over the top in lines.

recipes.title: Misir wot (Ethiopian red lentils)
recipes.note: She has eaten Ethiopian food twice (Aug 30, 2025 and Aug 29, 2026). Red lentils are cheap and the dish keeps for days.

items: Injera from an Ethiopian market, or flatbread

steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot over medium heat for 8–10 min, until soft and jammy.
Add 3 Tbsp butter, the garlic, ginger, 2–3 Tbsp berbere and 1 Tbsp tomato paste. Cook for 2 min.
Add the lentils and 3 cups water. Simmer 25 min, stirring often, until thick.

recipes.title: Burrito bowl with cilantro-lime rice
recipes.note: She bought a Chipotle bowl (May 27, 2026), and she builds her own bowls more than anything else.
steps: Stir lime juice, zest and chopped cilantro into hot rice.
Rub the chicken with blended chipotle, garlic and oil. Sear or grill it, then chop.
Corn salsa: corn, diced red onion, cilantro, lime and salt.
Build the bowls with rice, beans, chicken and salsa, then top with lettuce, cheese, sour cream and guac.

recipes.title: Turkish eggs (çılbır)
recipes.note: She has posted runny eggs on toast at least six times (Sep 2024 to Aug 2025), often with avocado and hot sauce. This puts the eggs on garlicky yogurt with chili butter.

items: Aleppo pepper (or paprika plus a pinch of chili flakes)

steps: Stir a grated garlic clove and a pinch of salt into 1 cup yogurt. Spread it on a plate.
Poach or fry 2 eggs until the whites are just set and lay them on the yogurt.
Melt 2 Tbsp butter with 1 tsp Aleppo pepper and spoon it over. Add dill and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Pumpkin pie chia pudding
recipes.note: Chia with blueberries and pepitas (Sep 27, 2026) and chocolate chia with raspberries (Sep 16, 2026). A fall flavor using the same method.
steps: Whisk everything except the yogurt and pepitas. Stir again after 10 min so it doesn't clump.
Chill overnight. Top with a spoon of yogurt and toasted pepitas.

recipes.title: Lemon blueberry baked oats
recipes.note: She has posted yogurt, granola and blueberry bowls many times (Jan 31 and Feb 3, 2026) and made a lemon dessert (Nov 11, 2024). One pan covers breakfast for several days.
steps: Mash the banana and whisk in the eggs, milk, yogurt, maple syrup and lemon zest.
Stir in the oats and baking powder, then fold in the blueberries.
Bake in a greased 8×8 pan at 375°F for 25–30 min, until set in the middle.

recipes.title: Butternut squash mac and cheese
recipes.note: A combination of her squash soup (Sep 23, 2026) and her cheesy sausage-and-pepper pasta (Sep 28, 2026).

items: 2 cups roasted or frozen butternut squash

steps: Blend the squash with 1 cup warm milk and garlic until smooth.
Heat the purée and stir in 1½ cups cheddar, ½ cup parmesan, nutmeg and salt.
Toss with the cooked pasta. Top with panko or pepitas and broil 2–3 min.

recipes.title: Thai red curry squash soup
recipes.note: The squash soup she already makes, with Thai flavors like the takeout she orders.
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger. Stir in the curry paste for 1 min.
Add the squash, coconut milk and 2 cups broth. Simmer 20 min, until the squash is soft.
Blend until smooth and add lime juice to taste. Top with a swirl of coconut milk, cilantro and pepitas.

recipes.title: Korean ground beef bowls
recipes.note: Ground beef is the meat she cooks most (taco meat, taco salads, lettuce wraps on Mar 2, 2026), and rice bowls with scallions and a mayo drizzle are her favorite format.
steps: Brown the beef and drain most of the fat. Add 3 cloves of garlic and 1 tsp grated ginger for 1 min.
Stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and 1 Tbsp gochujang if using. Simmer 2–3 min until glossy.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber, scallions and sesame seeds. Add a fried egg and drizzle sriracha mayo in lines.

recipes.title: Miso-glazed salmon
recipes.note: She has made salmon over rice with scallions five times (March 2025, August 2026). A sweet-salty glaze is an easy change from her usual.
steps: Whisk the miso, honey, soy sauce and vinegar together.
Set the salmon on a foil-lined pan and brush thickly with the glaze.
Broil 7–10 min, until the top caramelizes and the fish flakes. Watch closely, because the glaze burns fast.
Serve over rice with cucumber, scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan chicken
recipes.note: She made a creamy chicken and spinach pasta (Nov 6, 2025) and finishes nearly everything with parmesan. This is the same sauce with sun-dried tomatoes.

items: 2 chicken breasts (sliced in half to make thin cutlets)

steps: Season the cutlets and sear in oil, 4–5 min per side, until cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 min. Add the cream, parmesan and 1 tsp Italian seasoning.
Simmer 3 min, stir in the spinach until wilted, then return the chicken.
Serve over pasta, or with bread for the sauce.

recipes.title: Honey-garlic pork tenderloin with green beans
recipes.note: She roasted a pork tenderloin and served it with green beans in spring 2025, and blistered green beans or asparagus show up with a lot of her dinners. This version cooks everything on one pan.
steps: Simmer the honey, soy sauce, garlic and butter for 2 min to make the glaze.
Put the pork in the middle of a sheet pan and toss the green beans with oil and salt around it. Brush the pork with half the glaze.
Roast at 425°F for 20–25 min, until the center of the pork reads 145°F. Rest 5 min.
Slice, then spoon the rest of the glaze over the top.

recipes.title: Garlic butter shrimp orzo
recipes.note: She has made shrimp alfredo (Sep 25, 2024) and shrimp with ravioli (July 2024), plus a creamy orzo with broccoli. This combines the shrimp and the orzo.

items: a handful of spinach or parsley

steps: Melt the butter and toast the orzo with the garlic for 2 min.
Add the broth and simmer, stirring now and then, for about 8 min until almost tender.
Nestle in the seasoned shrimp, cover and cook 3–4 min until pink.
Stir in the lemon zest and juice, parmesan and greens.

recipes.title: Freezer breakfast burritos
recipes.note: She has posted burritos with tater tots (spring 2026) and an egg-and-tots plate (this past winter). These put everything in one wrap that keeps in the freezer.

items: 3 cups frozen tater tots or hash browns

steps: Bake the tots until crisp. Brown the sausage. Softly scramble the eggs.
Let everything cool for 10 min so the tortillas don't go soggy.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, sausage, tots, cheese and a spoon of salsa. Roll tightly and wrap in foil.
Freeze. To reheat, remove the foil, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave 2–3 min, turning once.

recipes.title: Street corn pasta salad
recipes.note: She makes pasta salads (a caprese one in August 2025) and cowboy caviar (Sep 16, 2026). This brings Mexican street-corn flavors to a pasta salad.
steps: Cook the pasta and rinse it under cold water.
Char the corn in a dry skillet over high heat until it browns in spots.
Whisk the mayo, sour cream, lime juice and chili powder.
Toss everything together and top with extra cotija and a sprinkle of chili powder.

recipes.title: Salsa verde shredded chicken
recipes.note: Chicken goes into a lot of her Tex-Mex meals, like the chicken and black bean bowl (May 18, 2026). One batch makes enough for bowls, tacos and quesadillas all week.

items: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs or breasts

steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker with the seasonings and pour the salsa over.
Cook on low 6 hr or high 3–4 hr.
Shred with two forks right in the pot, then stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Serve in bowls or tacos with avocado and sour cream.

recipes.title: Crispy pork carnitas
recipes.note: Her tacos and burrito bowls (steak tacos Nov 18, 2025; a Chipotle bowl May 27, 2026) are a natural fit for carnitas, and a quick broil makes the pork crispy.

items: 3–4 lb pork shoulder (cut in large chunks)

steps: Rub the pork with the salt and spices. Put it in the slow cooker on top of the sliced onion and garlic.
Squeeze the orange and lime juice over the top and add the spent halves. Cook on low 8–10 hr.
Shred, spread on a sheet pan and spoon over some of the juices.
Broil 3–5 min until the edges crisp. Serve in tortillas with onion, cilantro and salsa.

recipes.title: Beef chili with all the toppings
recipes.note: She posted chili with avocado, sour cream and cilantro, with cornbread on the side, on Oct 7, 2026. A slow-cooker batch covers several dinners.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in a skillet first, then drain. Raw ground beef shouldn't go straight into a slow cooker.
Add it to the slow cooker with everything else and 1 tsp salt.
Cook on low 6–8 hr. Taste and adjust the salt.
Top with avocado, sour cream, cheddar, cilantro and scallions. Serve with cornbread.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.note: She makes a lot of tomato-cream sauces and a lot of dinners over rice. This is a new flavor in that same style.

items: ¾ cup heavy cream or coconut milk

steps: Add everything except the cream to the slow cooker with 1 tsp salt and stir.
Cook on low 6 hr or high 3–4 hr.
Stir in the cream and cook 15 min more on high.
Serve over rice with cilantro and warm naan.

recipes.title: Beef and broccoli
recipes.note: She makes chicken and broccoli stir-fries (Jan 24, 2025) and orders takeout often. This is a takeout classic that cooks while she's out.

items: 1½ lb flank steak or chuck (sliced thin)

steps: Whisk the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and garlic in the slow cooker. Add the beef.
Cook on low 5–6 hr.
Mix the cornstarch with 3 Tbsp water and stir it in with the broccoli. Cook on high 30 min, until the sauce thickens.
Serve over rice with sesame seeds and scallions.

recipes.title: Sausage, white bean and kale soup
recipes.note: She made beef stew with white beans (Oct 29, 2025) and often serves soup with garlic toast and parmesan. This is a lighter Italian-style soup.
steps: Brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, then add it to the slow cooker.
Add the chopped vegetables, garlic, beans, tomatoes, broth, seasoning and parmesan rind.
Cook on low 6–8 hr. Stir in the chopped kale for the last 30 min.
Serve with shredded parmesan and garlic toast.

recipes.title: Chicken pot pie soup with biscuits
recipes.note: Her corn chowder (Dec 3, 2025) and slow-cooker soup (Dec 2, 2024) show she likes a creamy, hearty bowl. This is pot pie in soup form.
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the butter for 6–8 min. Add the garlic.
Stir in the flour for 1 min, then whisk in the broth and milk. Simmer 10 min, until thick.
Add the chicken, peas and thyme and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the biscuits and set one on top of each bowl.

recipes.title: Apple cider pork chops with roasted squash
recipes.note: She roasted pork tenderloin twice in June 2025 and made squash soup on Sep 23, 2026. This puts fall flavors on a weeknight pork dinner.
steps: Toss the squash with oil, salt and cinnamon and roast at 425°F for 25–30 min.
Season the chops and sear 4–5 min per side, until 145°F inside. Rest on a plate.
In the same pan, cook the apple slices 2 min. Add the cider, Dijon and brown sugar and boil until reduced by half, about 5 min.
Swirl in the butter and thyme and spoon over the chops.

recipes.title: Sausage baked ziti
recipes.note: Red-sauce pasta is her most-posted dish, and she has made sausage and pepper pasta three times. This bakes them together under melted cheese.
steps: Cook the ziti 2 min less than the package says.
Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic, then stir in the marinara.
Mix the ricotta, egg and half the parmesan. Toss the pasta with the sauce, layer it in a 9×13 with spoonfuls of ricotta, and top with mozzarella and the rest of the parmesan.
Bake covered at 375°F for 20 min, then uncovered 15 min until bubbly.

recipes.title: Pumpkin cinnamon rolls
recipes.note: She made cinnamon rolls (Jul 29, 2024) and frosted bars for Thanksgiving (Nov 27, 2025). These are her rolls with pumpkin in the dough.
steps: Stir the yeast into the warm milk and wait 5 min. Mix in everything else and knead 6–8 min. The dough is sticky, so add flour 1 Tbsp at a time only if needed.
Let it rise 1–1½ hours, until doubled.
Roll to 16×12 inches, spread the filling, roll up and cut 12 rolls. Rise 45 min.
Bake at 350°F for 22–26 min. Beat the icing ingredients and spread on while warm.

recipes.title: Pasta marinara with garlic toast
recipes.note: Rigatoni or spaghetti in red sauce under grated parmesan, usually with garlic toast.
steps: Warm the sliced garlic in the oil for 1 min. Add the tomatoes, oregano, chili flakes and a pinch each of salt and sugar. Simmer 15 min.
Toss with the cooked pasta and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan and basil.
Garlic toast: spread bread with butter, sprinkle garlic powder and parmesan, and broil 2–3 min.

recipes.title: Pappardelle with meat sauce
recipes.note: Wide ribbon pasta in a meaty tomato sauce with shaved parmesan and basil.
steps: Brown the beef with the finely chopped onion and carrot. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 1 min.
Add the tomatoes and seasoning and simmer at least 30 min. Stir in the milk at the end.
Toss with the pappardelle and top with shaved parmesan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and homemade meatballs
recipes.madeDates: Dec 10, 2025 (the meatballs got their own post)
recipes.note: Browned meatballs in marinara over spaghetti with lots of parmesan.
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 min, then gently mix in everything else except the sauce and pasta.
Roll into 1½-inch balls and bake at 400°F for 15–18 min, until cooked through (160°F inside).
Simmer the meatballs in marinara for 10 min and serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Fettuccine alfredo
recipes.note: Fettuccine in a creamy parmesan sauce, once with shrimp and once with broccoli.

items: 1 lb shrimp or 2 cups broccoli florets

steps: If using shrimp, cook them in 1 Tbsp butter for 2–3 min and set aside. Steam or boil the broccoli if using.
Melt the rest of the butter, add the garlic for 30 sec, then the cream. Simmer 3 min.
Take it off the heat and stir in the parmesan. Toss with the pasta, a splash of pasta water, and the shrimp or broccoli.

recipes.title: Creamy chicken and spinach pasta
recipes.note: Rigatoni in a creamy sauce with chicken, spinach and parsley.
steps: Season and brown the chicken in oil until cooked through.
Add the garlic for 30 sec, then the cream and parmesan. Simmer 2–3 min.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then toss with the pasta and some pasta water.

recipes.title: Sausage and pepper pasta
recipes.madeDates: Mar 15, 2025 · Jun 23, 2025 · Sep 28, 2026 (a cheesy skillet version)
recipes.note: Short pasta with sausage, roasted red peppers and onion, finished with parmesan.
steps: Brown the sausage, sliced or crumbled. Add the sliced peppers and onion and cook until soft and charred in spots.
Add the garlic for 1 min.
Toss with the pasta, pasta water and parmesan. For the cheesy skillet, stir in the cream and cheddar until melted.

recipes.title: Imitation crab pasta
recipes.note: Pasta with pink-and-white strips that look like imitation crab, once with pesto and once in a cream sauce.

items: ⅓ cup pesto or ½ cup cream plus ½ cup parmesan

steps: Warm the garlic in the butter, then add the crab for 2 min.
Add the pesto, or the cream and parmesan, and heat through.
Toss with the pasta and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Bacon carbonara
recipes.note: Pasta with crispy bacon pieces and a cheesy coating.
steps: Crisp the chopped bacon and keep 1 Tbsp of the fat in the pan.
Whisk the eggs, cheese and pepper together.
Off the heat, toss the hot pasta with the bacon, then the egg mixture and a splash of pasta water, stirring fast until creamy so the eggs don't scramble.

recipes.title: Chicken parmesan
recipes.note: Breaded chicken under marinara and melted cheese, served over pasta.

items: 1 cup breadcrumbs mixed with ¼ cup parmesan

steps: Coat the cutlets in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumb mix.
Pan-fry in oil 3–4 min per side, or air fry at 400°F for 10–12 min.
Top with marinara and mozzarella and broil until bubbly. Serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Garlic shrimp and mushrooms with ravioli
recipes.note: Seared shrimp and browned mushrooms with large ravioli.
steps: Brown the sliced mushrooms in a dry hot pan, then add the butter and garlic.
Add the shrimp and cook 2–3 min until pink.
Toss with the cooked ravioli, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Italian pasta salad
recipes.note: Rotini with mozzarella pearls, cherry tomatoes, olives, chickpeas, peppers and basil.

items: ½ cup Italian dressing (or olive oil, red wine vinegar and oregano)

steps: Cook the pasta and rinse it under cold water.
Toss with everything else and the dressing.
Chill 30 min before serving.

recipes.title: Pan-fried gnocchi with chicken and pesto
recipes.note: Golden gnocchi tossed with chicken and herbs.
steps: Pan-fry the gnocchi straight from the package in oil until golden, about 6 min. No boiling needed.
Brown the chicken in the same pan.
Toss everything with the pesto and top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Homemade pepperoni pizza
recipes.note: A charred, bubbly pizza on a pizza peel, and a second round with jalapeño and garlic flatbread slices.
steps: Heat the oven with a pizza stone or steel at 500°F for 45 min.
Stretch the dough on a floured peel and add the sauce, cheese and toppings.
Slide onto the stone and bake 7–10 min, until the crust has dark spots.

recipes.title: Taco salad
recipes.note: Seasoned ground meat over shredded lettuce with cheddar, tomato, guacamole or avocado, and sour cream in lines.

items: taco seasoning (2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and salt)

steps: Brown the meat, add the seasoning and ¼ cup water, and simmer 3 min.
Pile the meat on shredded lettuce.
Add the toppings and drizzle sour cream in lines.

recipes.title: Quesadillas
recipes.note: Golden quesadillas cut in wedges, sometimes with beans or meat, sour cream on the side.
steps: Spread the filling and cheese on half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a buttered skillet over medium heat 2–3 min per side, until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Burritos with pico de gallo
recipes.note: Flour tortilla burritos, one opened up to show fresh pico de gallo.

items: seasoned ground beef or black beans

steps: Make the pico by dicing everything and mixing with lime and salt.
Warm the tortillas, fill, fold in the sides and roll up.
For a crisp outside, sear seam-side down in a dry skillet for 2 min.

recipes.title: Steak tacos
recipes.note: Soft flour tortillas with seasoned beef, lettuce and tomato.
steps: Rub the steak with the spices, garlic, lime and salt.
Sear in a very hot pan 3–4 min per side. Rest 5 min and slice thin across the grain.
Fill the warm tortillas and top.

recipes.title: Chili with cornbread
recipes.note: Bean and tomato chili topped with avocado, sour cream lines and cilantro, with cornbread once.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion. Add the garlic and spices for 1 min.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer 30 min, stirring now and then.
Bake the cornbread from the box while it simmers. Top the chili with avocado, sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Cowboy caviar
recipes.note: A big bowl of beans, chickpeas, corn, tomatoes, peppers and red onion.
steps: Rinse and drain the beans. Dice the vegetables.
Whisk the dressing and toss with everything.
Chill at least 30 min. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Steak bites with corn salsa and guacamole
recipes.note: Seared steak pieces over corn and black bean salsa with guacamole in the middle.
steps: Toss the salsa ingredients with lime juice and salt.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt.
Cube and season the steak, sear in a very hot pan 2–3 min, and serve over the salsa with the guac.

recipes.title: Southwest chicken chopped salad
recipes.note: Sliced seared chicken over chopped peppers, black beans, corn, red onion and tomatoes.
steps: Season the chicken and sear 5–6 min per side, until 165°F. Rest and slice.
Chop the vegetables and toss with the dressing.
Top with the chicken.

recipes.title: Mexican rice, refried beans and guacamole
recipes.note: A plate of orange Mexican rice, refried beans and chunky guacamole.
steps: Toast the rice in the oil until golden. Add the onion and garlic for 2 min.
Add the tomato sauce, broth and cumin. Cover and simmer on low 18–20 min, then rest 5 min.
Warm the beans and mash the avocados with lime, salt and cilantro.

recipes.title: Fried eggs on avocado toast
recipes.note: Runny fried eggs on toast or English muffins with mashed avocado, pepper or hot sauce.
steps: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Fry the eggs in butter over medium heat until the whites set and the yolks are still runny.
Spread the avocado on the toast, add the eggs and season.

recipes.title: Egg salad toast
recipes.note: Chunky egg salad with herbs piled on toast.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 11–12 min. Move to an ice bath.
Peel, chop and mix with the mayo, mustard, herbs, salt and pepper.
Pile onto toast.

recipes.title: Egg muffins
recipes.note: Baked egg cups with peppers, meat and cheese.
steps: Grease a 12-cup muffin tin and divide the fillings among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt and pour in until each cup is ¾ full.
Bake at 350°F for 18–22 min, until set. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Spinach and cheese breakfast casserole
recipes.note: A cheesy egg bake with greens in a square pan.
steps: Layer the hash browns, spinach and onion in a greased 9×13 pan.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over. Top with the cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 40–45 min, until the center is set.

recipes.title: Tomato and egg scramble
recipes.note: Soft scrambled eggs with cooked cherry tomatoes.
steps: Softly scramble the eggs in oil and set aside.
Cook the tomatoes with the sugar and salt until saucy, 3–4 min.
Fold the eggs back in and top with scallions. Serve with rice or toast.

recipes.title: Yogurt and granola bowls
recipes.note: Greek yogurt with granola, blueberries, strawberries or banana.
steps: Mix the granola ingredients and spread on a lined sheet pan.
Bake at 325°F for 25 min, stirring halfway. Let it cool on the pan so it forms clusters.
Layer with yogurt and fruit.

recipes.title: Chia pudding
recipes.madeDates: Sep 16, 2026 (chocolate, with raspberries) · Sep 27, 2026 (with blueberries and pepitas)
recipes.note: Chia pudding in plain and chocolate versions, topped with fruit and seeds.
steps: Whisk everything together and let it sit 10 min.
Whisk again so it doesn't clump, then chill at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with berries and pepitas.

recipes.title: Salmon poke bowl
recipes.note: Cubed salmon over rice with cucumber, avocado, scallions, chili crisp and Japanese mayo.
steps: Cube the salmon and toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil and vinegar. Keep it cold for 10 min. Buy raw fish labeled sushi-grade from a counter you trust.
Season warm rice with a little rice vinegar and salt.
Arrange everything over the rice, add chili crisp and drizzle the mayo in lines.

recipes.title: Seared ahi tuna bowls
recipes.note: Rare seared tuna, sometimes sesame-crusted, with avocado, cucumber, edamame, carrot and spicy mayo.
steps: Pat the tuna dry, brush with soy sauce and press into sesame seeds.
Sear in a very hot oiled pan 45–60 sec per side, so the middle stays pink. Slice.
Build the bowls and drizzle spicy mayo in lines.

recipes.title: Glazed salmon over rice
recipes.note: A glazed salmon fillet over white rice with scallions, asparagus or green beans.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, sriracha and grated garlic.
Sear the salmon 3 min, flip, pour in the glaze and cook 3–4 min more, spooning it over, until the fish flakes.
Roast the asparagus at 425°F for 10 min. Serve everything over rice with scallions.

recipes.title: Chicken and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.note: Chicken with broccoli, carrots and edamame or peas in a glossy sauce, with rice and sesame seeds.
steps: Sear the bite-size chicken in a hot pan until cooked and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables 3–4 min.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and let it bubble until thick. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Orange chicken
recipes.note: Crispy chicken in a sticky orange glaze, made in a skillet and served over rice.
steps: Toss the chicken in the beaten egg, then the cornstarch.
Pan-fry in ¼ inch of oil until crisp and cooked through, or air fry at 400°F for 12–15 min.
Simmer the sauce until thick and toss with the chicken. Serve over rice with scallions.

recipes.title: Egg fried rice
recipes.note: A big skillet of fried rice with scrambled egg and herbs.
steps: Scramble the eggs in oil and set aside.
Cook the garlic and peas for 1 min, then add the rice. Spread it out and let it sit to toast.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and scallions.

recipes.title: Lettuce wraps
recipes.note: Butter lettuce cups filled with saucy ground meat and scallions.
steps: Brown the meat and add the garlic and ginger.
Add the water chestnuts and sauces and cook 2 min.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Ramen noodle stir-fry
recipes.note: Noodles tossed with chicken, broccoli, carrot and peppers.

items: 2 packs instant ramen (skip the seasoning) or rice noodles

steps: Boil the noodles 2 min and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken until cooked, then the vegetables for 3 min.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss over high heat.

recipes.title: Asian cucumber salad
recipes.note: Thin-sliced cucumbers with chili flakes in a light dressing.
steps: Slice the cucumbers thin, toss with the salt and let them sit 10 min. Drain.
Toss with everything else.
Chill until serving.

recipes.title: Loaded baked potatoes
recipes.note: Baked or twice-baked potatoes with bacon, cheddar, sour cream and scallions.
steps: Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 425°F for 50–60 min, until tender.
Split, fluff and add butter. Top with cheese, bacon, sour cream and scallions.
Twice-baked: scoop out the inside, mash with sour cream and cheese, refill and bake 15 min more.

recipes.title: Buffalo chicken stuffed potatoes
recipes.note: A baked potato stuffed with buffalo chicken, cheddar, sour cream and scallions.
steps: Toss the chicken with the buffalo sauce.
Split the baked potatoes, fill with chicken and top with cheese. Bake 10 min.
Finish with ranch or sour cream and scallions.

recipes.title: Sweet potatoes with spiced ground beef
recipes.note: Baked sweet potato with seasoned ground beef and a white garlic sauce.
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 400°F for 45–60 min.
Brown the beef with the spices and garlic.
Split the potatoes, fill with beef and drizzle with the yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Beef stew
recipes.note: Chunks of beef with red potatoes, carrots, celery and onion in broth.
steps: Toss the beef with the flour and salt and brown it in batches.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, garlic and tomato paste for 3 min. Add the broth and herbs.
Cover and simmer 1½–2 hours, adding the potatoes for the last 40 min. In a slow cooker: low for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Butternut squash soup
recipes.note: Smooth orange squash soup topped with pepitas.

items: ½ cup cream or coconut milk

steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the squash and broth and simmer 20 min, until soft.
Blend smooth, stir in the cream and top with pepitas.

recipes.title: Corn chowder
recipes.note: A creamy skillet soup with corn and potatoes.
steps: Cook the bacon if using, then the onion and celery until soft. Stir in the flour for 1 min.
Whisk in the broth and milk, add the potatoes and simmer 15 min.
Add the corn for 5 min. Mash some of the potatoes against the pot to thicken.

recipes.title: Slow-cooker chicken vegetable soup
recipes.note: A slow cooker full of soup with carrots, greens and noodles. It may have been leftover Thanksgiving turkey.
steps: Add everything except the greens and noodles to the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6–7 hours. Shred the chicken.
Add the noodles and greens and cook on high 20–30 min more.

recipes.title: Tomato soup with cheesy garlic toast
recipes.note: A bowl of red soup with parmesan and squares of cheesy garlic toast.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the butter. Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 20 min.
Blend and stir in the cream and basil.
Spread bread with garlic butter, top with cheese and broil until bubbly.

recipes.title: Caesar salad
recipes.note: Romaine with creamy dressing, croutons and parmesan, often with crispy chicken or bacon.
steps: Whisk the dressing.
Toss with the chopped romaine.
Top with croutons, parmesan and the chicken or bacon.

recipes.title: Balsamic asparagus and green beans
recipes.note: Charred asparagus and green beans with a dark glaze.
steps: Toss the vegetables with oil and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 10–12 min, or sear in a very hot skillet.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze.

recipes.title: Herb-crusted pork tenderloin
recipes.note: Sliced roast pork tenderloin with green beans and yellow squash.
steps: Rub the pork with Dijon, garlic, herbs and salt.
Sear on all sides for 5 min, then roast at 425°F for 12–18 min, until 145°F inside. Rest 5 min.
Roast or sauté the vegetables while it rests.

recipes.title: Crispy chicken wings
recipes.note: Wings with ranch or blue cheese, celery and carrots, sometimes buffalo style.
steps: Pat the wings very dry and toss with the baking powder, salt and garlic powder.
Air fry at 380°F for 20 min, flip, then 400°F for 5–8 min. Or bake on a rack at 425°F for 45 min.
Toss in buffalo sauce if you like and serve with dip.

recipes.title: Steak bites with sweet potato fries
recipes.note: Seared steak bites and sweet potato fries with a green dipping sauce.

items: ranch blended with a jalapeño and cilantro

steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into fries, toss with the cornstarch, oil, paprika and salt, and bake at 425°F for 25–30 min, turning once.
Cube the steak, season and sear in a very hot pan 2–3 min. Add butter and garlic for the last minute.
Blend the dip and serve.

recipes.title: Burgers, caprese or avocado-bacon
recipes.note: One burger with fresh mozzarella, tomato, basil and balsamic, and others with cheddar, avocado or bacon.
steps: Form ⅓-lb patties with a thumbprint in the middle and season well.
Cook 3–4 min per side, until 160°F inside. Add the cheese for the last minute with a lid on.
Build on toasted buns with your toppings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon rolls
recipes.note: Fat, swirled cinnamon rolls with white icing.
steps: Mix and knead the dough 6–8 min. Let it rise 1 hour.
Roll to 16×12 inches, spread the filling, roll up and cut 12 rolls. Rise 30–45 min.
Bake at 350°F for 22–25 min and spread the icing on while warm.

recipes.title: Frosted pumpkin bars
recipes.note: Squares with white frosting and a caramel-colored drizzle. I'm guessing pumpkin from the date and color.
steps: Whisk the wet ingredients, then stir in the dry.
Bake in a greased 10×15 pan at 350°F for 25–30 min. Cool completely.
Frost and drizzle with caramel.

recipes.title: Lemon icebox pie
recipes.note: A pale lemon dessert in a glass dish with a lemon slice on top.
steps: Beat the cream cheese until smooth, then the condensed milk, lemon juice and zest.
Pour into the crust.
Chill at least 4 hours and top with a lemon slice.
